real trail: blocked by open tickets — expect blocked
count 3, then a person's go-ahead — expect plan

real LIN-3309 trail: two Request Changes, no revision label — expect plan (control)
real LIN-3309 trail: count 2 plus a landed Revision 3 (this ticket's own state) — expect plan-review

PR-1603 trail: count 1, then an FC ruling posted as a comment — expect plan (F3d)

plan on record whose own text records 'plan-review due: yes' for criterion (d), credential surface, still unimplemented (expect -> plan-review; the designed primary path — the plan writes the decision, the router reads it)

plan on record that MEETS criterion (c) — it drops a validation assertion — but predates the gate, so it records no decision and the router must judge the criteria itself (expect -> plan-review; the fallback path, measured because scripts/eval-plan-review.mjs shows it is the weak one)

clean single-surface plan, gate met by NONE of (a)-(d), decision recorded as 'plan-review due: no' (expect -> implementation, NOT plan-review; this is the over-fire guard and the phase's acceptance criterion — zero added dispatches on a clean plan)

gated plan whose trail already carries a plan-review Approve, work still unimplemented (expect -> implementation: an Approve routes on session-fit exactly as before, and must NOT trigger a second plan-review — nor be read as close-out evidence)
gated plan whose trail carries ONE plan-review Request Changes (expect -> plan: the revision pass, the single exception to 'completed prep ⇒ never re-emit the prep verb')

same plan after one revision cycle, trail carries a SECOND Request Changes on the same unaddressed finding with no reply (expect -> plan: LIN-3309 moved the escalation point to the third unanswered Request Changes; the second is still the revision pass)

same plan after two revision cycles, trail carries a THIRD Request Changes so the code-computed count reaches 3 with no reply (expect -> blocked: LIN-3309 moves the escalation point from the second to the third unanswered Request Changes)
